# UITrackpadComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Number field of a script UI that the player can type into or drag; the callback gets the new value.

## Methods

### values {#values}

::: member

Sets how much one step (arrow click or drag unit) changes the value.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `normal` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | step without modifier keys |
| `weak` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | step while Alt is held |
| `strong` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | step while Shift is held |

**Returns** [`UITrackpadComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITrackpadComponent) — this number field

:::

### values {#values-2}

::: member

Sets the step; the Alt step becomes a fifth of it and the Shift step five times it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `normal` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | step without modifier keys |

**Returns** [`UITrackpadComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITrackpadComponent) — this number field

:::

### limit {#limit}

::: member

Limits the value the player can set.

```js
ui.trackpad(function (value) {
    c.send("Volume: " + value);
}).limit(0, 100).integer(true).value(50);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | smallest value |
| `max` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest value |

**Returns** [`UITrackpadComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITrackpadComponent) — this number field

:::
